bulk downloads are recommended for hundreds of properties.
INSPIRE Index Polygons is an open HM Land Registry dataset.
it contains locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales.
it is a subset of the wider Index Polygons database.
each INSPIRE polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID.
one registered title may contain several polygons with separate INSPIRE IDs.
INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent, not definitive title extent.
the individual title plan is needed to identify registered-title extent.
the dataset is updated on the first Sunday monthly using previous-month data.
the current public INSPIRE release was published on 5 July 2026.
public downloads are listed separately by local authority.
London Borough of Barnet is listed with a GML download.
London Borough of Enfield is listed with a GML download.
published files are GML and require GIS software to view.
download access remains until the next monthly update.
downloading the files is subject to OGL conditions.

National Polygon Service contains three licensed chargeable datasets.
National Polygon covers freehold and leasehold registered titles.
the service reports more than 25 million titles.
the service reports more than 28 million polygons.
National Polygon includes polygon ID and title number.
National Polygon is mapped against Ordnance Survey MasterMap.
the service is updated on the second working day monthly with previous-month data.
access requires licence agreement and payment.
National Polygon is the published HMLR Index Polygon dataset for England and Wales.
every registered title has at least one index polygon.
each index polygon has a unique Poly_ID.
title number links polygons to registered titles.
INSPIRE polygons are a simpler subset of National Polygon.
all HMLR index polygon data is captured to British National Grid.
index polygon extent can differ from the title-plan extent.
National Polygon is published and updated monthly.
HMLR uses GML as an open-standard geospatial format.
GML files can be converted to other GIS formats.
HMLR polygon data is captured against British National Grid.
polygon vertices are represented by X and Y grid coordinates.
QGIS can reproject BNG data into other coordinate systems.
Google/Bing workflows require reprojection from British National Grid.
the guidance identifies EPSG:3857 as a common web-map target CRS.
BNG-to-WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15 metres.
Time Stamped DTM is an Environment Agency raster elevation archive.
DTM uses last-return lidar with surface objects removed.
supply is GeoTIFF raster in 5km zip files.
heights are in metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
data is aligned to the Ordnance Survey Grid.
declared coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700.
dataset revision date is 19 July 2024 and period ends 18 April 2024.
Composite DTM 1m covers about 99 percent of England.
the Environment Agency produced this composite in 2022.
it combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys.
repeat-survey areas use the newest best-resolution source data.
resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation before merging.
the composite contains surveys from June 2000 to April 2022.
surface objects are removed to represent terrain rather than surface.
LIDAR_Tiles_Catalogues is a public Environment Agency FeatureServer.
the service spatial reference is EPSG:27700.
layer 0 is LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents.
layer 1 is LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Extents.
the service supports JSON query output.
the service reports a maximum record count of 1000.
the full extent is expressed in British National Grid metres.
service-level metadata alone does not provide candidate elevation values.
OS Terrain 50 grid is supplied in ASCII grid and GML 3.2.1.
contours are available in shapefile, GML, GeoPackage and vector tiles.
online download is available without registration.
tiled national supply uses 10km by 10km tiles.
the product contains 2,858 tiles arranged into 55 folders.
full national grid-tile supply is about 157 MB compressed.
the product uses annual full-tile resupply.
the annual update schedule is each July.
ASCII Terrain 50 is a text-based raster DTM format.
height values are calculated from pixel centres.
each tile row contains 200 pixel values.
rows read from west to east.
height values are provided to the nearest 0.1m.
ASCII supply includes a companion GML metadata file.
the example header specifies ncols 200, nrows 200 and cellsize 50.
productId is a required path parameter.
fileName is an optional download filter.
format is an optional download filter.
subformat is an optional download filter.
area is an optional geographic filter and TQ is an allowed value.
successful list requests return HTTP 200 JSON.
redirect with exactly one matching download returns HTTP 307.
